left.title: Senate panel narrowly endorses Mike Pompeo for secretary of state after Trump intervenes with key Republican
left.body: Secretary of state nominee Mike Pompeo narrowly eked out an endorsement from the Senate Foreign Relations Committee on Monday after President Trump and a Democratic senator intervened at the last minute, all but guaranteeing that he will be confirmed by the full Senate later this week.
left.roundup: The Senate Foreign Relations Committee approved the nomination of President Trump’s choice for secretary of state, Mike Pompeo, after Senator Rand Paul (R-KY) decided to support the CIA director.

center.title: Senate committee paves way for Pompeo to become top U.S. diplomat
center.body: A Senate committee approved the nomination of President Donald Trump’s choice for secretary of state, Mike Pompeo, on Monday after a Republican senator who had been opposed threw his support behind the CIA director in the face of party pressure.
center.roundup: The Senate Foreign Relations Committee approved the nomination of President Trump’s choice for secretary of state, Mike Pompeo, after Senator Rand Paul (R-KY) decided to support the CIA director.

right.title: 'We Should See This More Often': Democrat Casts Shocking Pompeo Vote to Help Mourning GOP Friend
right.body: In a surprising twist, the Senate Foreign Relations Committee will send President Donald Trump's pick for secretary of state, Mike Pompeo, to the Senate floor with a favorable recommendation.
right.roundup: The Senate Foreign Relations Committee approved the nomination of President Trump’s choice for secretary of state, Mike Pompeo, after Senator Rand Paul (R-KY) decided to support the CIA director.
